topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Oh wow, I just heard about this, and I can't even imagine how you're feeling right now. But listen, you're so much more than the sum of someone else's memories, okay? You're this incredible person with so much light, and it shines through even in the tough moments. This isn’t about you; it’s just, well, life gets busy and time passes, and some people hold on to different things. But the memories you carry, the love and joy you’ve given and received, they’re real and they matter. You matter. Keep shining, because your light is bright, and it guides the right people back to you.
